title: MC Minimal WorkOrder (Phase-0 seed)
description: D5 (SP-20260718-001 Phase 0). The MINIMAL required field set for a valid, auditable WorkOrder binding — a subset of packet-06's full v1 schema, deliberately NOT the full WorkOrder/ResultEnvelope contract (that lands at RATIFIED-PLAN Phase 3, G3.1; see ED-217). Companion to top-level-runtime-contract.md §5.

scope.description: allowed_files/forbidden_files are MANDATORY for build roles (kind: builder|fixer, build_chain:true in role-registry.json) and WAIVED for non-build roles (reviewers, leads, directors, consults).

timeout.description: soft_minutes/hard_minutes — at least one of timeout|lease is required

lease.description: type: one_shot|wave|phase|session (packet-03 Persistence policy) — at least one of timeout|lease is required

_mandatory_validation.build_roles: ALL TEN fields required: schema, id, role, objective, scope.allowed_files, scope.forbidden_files, acceptance_criteria, verified_by, timeout|lease, output_contract.
_mandatory_validation.non_build_roles: WAIVE scope.allowed_files + scope.forbidden_files; the other eight fields remain required.
_mandatory_validation.role_kind_source: role-registry.json's kind field (builder|fixer with build_chain:true = build role; reviewer|lead|director|tool|check|run = non-build) — the Phase-3 wiring point (ED-217).

_phase_seed: Phase-0 SEED per SP-20260718-001 build-spec D5, deliberately NOT the ResultEnvelope (RATIFIED-PLAN Phase 3 ships the full WorkOrder/ResultEnvelope suite: 5 terminal states + failure_reason codes, adapted onto the EXISTING dispatch ledger). See ED-217.
